summary: This directory manages the core business logic and state transitions required to process user requests, acting as the central coordination layer between input validation, data persistence, and external service communication.
responsibilities: Managing state transitions for core entities
Coordinating interactions between data layers and service adapters
relationships: The orchestration layer governs the state transitions of domain entities based on business rules.
Business logic interacts with data layers to persist entity state changes.
Domain entities maintain internal consistency throughout the orchestration process.
designDecisions: Centralization of business rules to ensure consistency
Separation of concerns by isolating logic from infrastructure
Explicit state management to track process progression
